clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley and the orchard purchase, 1952-1953
clusters.reason: Within the year after Walter moved the family to Sorrel Valley you said June wrote home anxiously, Walter stayed distant in the trees, Glen fought at his new school, Walter cut off his brother Harlan, June took to her bed, and the two of them rowed over money, with June's choir joining and lighter letters around late 1953 where things settle; Faye's stomach aches and Roy's held-back year are left out since no one is sure of their dates.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968-1969
clusters.reason: Around the frost that ruined the crop and the bank calling in the loan, within the following year and a half you said Walter drank heavily and clashed with Glen over blame, Glen and Marian took over the money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma worsened then eased, you began wetting the bed again, and Ida's heart trouble was found, settling once Walter stopped drinking and took up pruning work; the cutoff from Roy and the sale itself are left out as their dates are unsure.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the Ridgeport cannery, 1975-1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job at the cannery, within the year you said he sat idle for months, he and Marian fought over money and then both took on more work, you stopped eating properly and kept to your room away from your mother, and Walter began drinking again after years off it, with things settling once you were eating again and Glen started the delivery job; Carl's time at his girlfriend's and Tess's nightmares are left out as their dates are unsure.

clusters.name: Wilma's move into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990-1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into your house, within the next year and a half you said you clashed with her over the children, Hollis worked late and kept out of it before taking his mother's side, Owen had tantrums at preschool, Wilma took over Lily's care, your eczema flared, and you and Hollis fought most nights, settling as the eczema cleared over the summer after Wilma took her own flat; your mother's weekly visits to take your side are left out as their date is unsure.
